title: Saturation and No-Go Theorems for Scalar Poisson Certificates of Gaussian Mass Maximality
summary: Regev and Stephens-Davidowitz conjectured that the Gaussian mass $Θ_Λ(t) = \sum_{x \in Λ} e^{-t\lVert x\rVert^2}$ of any integral lattice $Λ\subset \mathbb{R}^n$ is bounded above by $Θ_{\mathbb{Z}^n}(t)$. For $n\ge 4$, we prove a saturation theorem for the natural scalar Poisson-summation certificates of this conjecture: any such certificate that is sharp at $\mathbb{Z}^n$ must interpolate the Gaussian, and have vanishing Fourier transform, at every nonzero point of integer squared norm.
